ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in scattered surface punctae.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling is localized on the distal 10% of the left lobe. Discrete white spots (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) are randomly distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 120 degrees; vertical depth occupies less than 10% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous fine-scale serration with low amplitude (1-3 pixels) along the entire trailing edge, with increased irregularity and deeper valleys on the distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a sigmoidal sweep, beginning with a slight convex curve near the notch and transitioning to a concave upward curve toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-intensity circular points are located on the extreme right distal tip and along the superior margin of the left lobe distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white striations (rake marks) are visible in the central-left region, oriented diagonally from the trailing edge toward the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular deformation and tissue loss on the distal tip of the left lobe, creating a ragged profile compared to the more rounded right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical alignment of white punctate marks is visible on the inner-trailing edge of the right lobe.
